channel.description: Product catalog feed for Who's A Good Boy Pet Accessories & Toys

item.g:title: Ultimate Puppy Starter Kit
item.g:description: Day one, done. • The things every new puppy parent buys anyway — collar & leash set, light-up safety collar, and a first squeaky toy — in one box. • Grows with them: adjustable sizing and durable builds mean this kit lasts past the puppy phase. Bundle & save: $46.99 (reg. $55.02 if bought separately). Inside the box: the Nylon Pup Set — a nylon collar & leash set in 7 colors and 4 sizes (S–XL, from $21.04) — the USB-rechargeable LED Light-Up Pet Collar in 9 colors and two lengths (50/70 cm), and the fully waterproof Waterproof Squeak Dog Toy Ball with a built-in squeaker, in 3 colors.
item.g:brand: Who's A Good Boy Pet Accessories

item.g:title: Boredom Buster Play Set
item.g:description: Three textures, zero boredom. • A full enrichment rotation in one box: crinkle-plush octopus, squeaky ball, and a durable bite stick — three textures that keep your dog guessing. • Built for power chewers: every piece is picked for durability, so the fun doesn't end on day two. Bundle & save: $48.99 (reg. $55.97 if bought separately). Inside the box: the Plush Octopus Pet Toy (a plush octopus with dangly tentacles, in 4 colors), the waterproof Waterproof Squeak Dog Toy Ball with a built-in squeaker (3 colors), and the Durable Training Bite Stick Dog Toy for tug and bite training (3 sizes, 20–30 cm).
item.g:brand: Who's A Good Boy Pet Accessories

item.g:title: PurrPlay & Octopus Cat Bundle
item.g:description: Double the toys, double the fun. This two-toy enrichment kit pairs the PurrPlay Self-Rolling Cat Toy Ball with the Plush Octopus Pet Toy. The PurrPlay ball moves on its own with random direction changes, triggering your cat's natural hunting instincts — stalk, chase, pounce, repeat — to keep indoor cats active day and night. The plush octopus is built for kick-and-cuddle play, with dangly tentacles pets love to grab and carry, perfect for gentle play, snuggles, and comfort. As always, supervise play and retire worn toys. Bundle & save 10%: $33.28 (reg. $36.98 if bought separately).
item.g:brand: Who's A Good Boy Pet Accessories

item.g:title: Night Walk Safety Bundle
item.g:description: Light up the night walk. The Night Walk Safety Bundle pairs two walk essentials in one kit: the LED Light-Up Pet Collar in the Yellow LED variant and the Everyday Durable Nylon Dog Leash. The collar's bright LED illumination helps your dog stand out in low light and darkness, so you're both easier to see after dark. It's USB rechargeable with slim, lightweight everyday wear. The leash is durable woven nylon built for daily use, with secure clasp hardware and a comfortable grip for reliable control. Two essentials, one simple kit — evenings just got brighter.
item.g:brand: Who's A Good Boy Pet Accessories

item.g:title: Squeak & Train Play Bundle
item.g:description: Play hard, train smart. This two-toy kit pairs the Interactive Squeaky Dog Toy with the Durable Training Bite Stick Dog Toy for fetch, tug, and training. The squeaky toy moves unpredictably on its own to trigger chase and pounce instincts, and squeaks to keep your dog engaged long after you'd have quit throwing. The bite stick is the one trainers reach for: built for serious tug and bite training, with an easy-grip stick shape that's comfortable for your hand and irresistible for their jaws. As always, supervise play and retire worn toys. Bundle & save 10%: $44.08 (reg. $48.98 if bought separately).
item.g:brand: Who's A Good Boy Pet Accessories

item.g:title: PuppyPalace 30" Calming Dog Bed — Plush Anti-Anxiety Donut Cuddler (Dark Grey, Medium) - Dark Grey / Medium (30x30")
item.g:description: Meet the PuppyPalace 30" Calming Dog Bed — the donut-shaped cuddler your pup has been dreaming about! 🐾 This plush, round bed is designed to wrap your best friend in cozy comfort. Its raised rim gives sleepy heads the perfect place to rest, while the deep, soft crevices invite natural burrowing and curling up — just like nesting with their pack. Many pups find the snug donut shape extra soothing, making it a great pick for nap time, bedtime, and lazy afternoons. Why good boys and girls love it: Plush, fluffy faux-fur surface for maximum snuggle factor Raised rim supports the head and neck for extra-comfy snoozing Deep crevices encourage natural burrowing instincts Removable, washable cover for easy clean-up after muddy-paw adventures Medium 30" x 30" size in handsome Dark Grey that suits any room Care instructions: Remove the cover and machine wash cold on a gentle cycle, then tumble dry low or line dry. Fluff it up between washes to keep it extra cozy. Shipping note: This bed ships from a US warehouse, and delivery usually takes about 2 days.
item.g:brand: Who's A Good Boy Pet Accessories

item.g:title: Super Bird Creations Balsa Rainbow Bird Toy - Standard
item.g:description: Rainbow? Check. Shreddable? Oh yes. Balsa is basically bird candy — soft, chewy, and irresistible to beaks that need to stay busy. This colorful balsa toy gives your feathered friend something fun to chew, shred, and happily demolish, which means more beak exercise and less mischief aimed at your furniture. Why birdies love it: Soft balsa wood is made for chewing and shredding Bright rainbow colors keep curious eyes entertained Encourages natural foraging instincts and healthy beak activity A beak-pleasing pick for pet birds who love to chew Good to know: Supervise play and discontinue use if the product becomes damaged. Choose with confidence: Pick a toy suited to your bird's size and chewing style. Practical pet gear, clear details, and no guesswork — that's the WHO'S A GOOD BOY way.
item.g:brand: Who's A Good Boy Pet Accessories

item.g:title: Bird Recovery Collar (Anti-Bite) - African Grey
item.g:description: Healing takes time. This collar makes it easier. Feather plucking, wound picking, post-procedure nibbling — birds can be their own worst patients. This soft recovery collar gently keeps curious beaks away from sensitive spots so wounds can heal and feathers can regrow in peace. Why bird parents love it: Soft, comfortable design — kinder than a rigid cone Helps protect healing wounds and growing feathers from nibbling Lightweight so your bird can still eat, drink, and move around Adjustable fit for a snug, secure wear Good to know: Check fit, closures, and hardware before each use, and supervise your bird while wearing. Choose with confidence: Measure your bird's neck and compare against the size guide before ordering. Practical pet gear, clear details, and no guesswork — that's the WHO'S A GOOD BOY way.
item.g:brand: Who's A Good Boy Pet Accessories

item.g:title: Coconut Fiber Hanging Bird House with Ladder - Standard
item.g:description: A cozy hideaway for your bird. The Coconut Fiber Hanging Bird House with Ladder gives your bird a natural-style nest to rest and play in, with a ladder for easy access. Coconut fiber construction Hanging design with ladder Good to know: check the product images for size, confirm it suits your bird and cage, and replace it if it becomes frayed.
item.g:brand: Who's A Good Boy Pet Accessories

item.g:title: Bird Seed Storage Container (7 lb) - Gray-1Pack
item.g:description: Keep bird seed fresh and tidy. The Bird Seed Storage Container (7 lb) holds your bird's food in one place, keeping seed fresh, dry, and pest-free in a sealed clear container you can see into at a glance. It holds up to 7 lb of mixed seed — a generous supply for daily feeding without constant refills — and the easy-pour design makes topping up feeders quick and mess-free. The photos show the gray lid and carry handle (check the product images for the lid style). Offered in Gray-1Pack under Color. Good to know: store seed in a cool, dry place.
item.g:brand: Who's A Good Boy Pet Accessories

item.g:title: Portable Bird Carrier Backpack - Standard
item.g:description: Take your bird along wherever you go. The Portable Bird Carrier Backpack lets you carry your bird comfortably for vet visits, outings, and travel — a safe way to bring your feathered companion with you. The gray and black backpack-style carrier has clear windows, mesh panels for ventilation, and a pull-down perch tray, keeping your bird comfortable and secure on the move. The single Standard size is made for birds; check the product images for size and ventilation, and confirm it suits your bird before ordering. Never leave your bird unattended in the carrier, and make sure it's properly closed before heading out.
item.g:brand: Who's A Good Boy Pet Accessories

item.g:title: Parrot Bird Bathtub with Shower (USB Electric) - Standard
item.g:description: Make bath time easy and enjoyable. The Parrot Bird Bathtub with Shower (USB Electric) gives your pet bird a dedicated bathing spot with a gentle shower-style water flow — a fun way for birds to bathe on their own terms. The clear plastic tub pairs with a USB-powered pump that drives the shower, so setup is simple wherever you have a USB port. The single Standard size suits parrots and similar-sized pet birds; check the product images for size and setup, and make sure it suits your bird before ordering. Always supervise your bird during bath time, and rinse and dry the tub after use to keep it clean.
item.g:brand: Who's A Good Boy Pet Accessories

item.g:title: Hamster Wooden Swing Toy & Hanging Bed - Swing
item.g:description: A swing AND a bed? Somebody's living the good life. This natural wood swing moonlights as a cozy hanging hideaway — perfect for tiny climbers who love to snooze up high. Little paws get something grippy to scamper across (and yes, gnaw on), while the hanging design frees up precious floor space for important burrowing business below. Why tiny paws love it: Two-in-one fun: a swing for playtime, a hideaway for naptime Natural wood is paw-friendly and gnaw-approved Hangs securely from the cage top — no wobbles, no worries A great fit for hamsters, gerbils, and mice Good to know: Supervise play and discontinue use if the product becomes damaged. Choose with confidence: Check the hanging length and swing size against your pet's needs and the space in their habitat. Practical pet gear, clear details, and no guesswork — that's the WHO'S A GOOD BOY way.
item.g:brand: Who's A Good Boy Pet Accessories

item.g:title: Hamster Flying Saucer Exercise Wheel (Blue) - Blue
item.g:description: Who needs an ordinary wheel when you can have a flying saucer? This saucer-style exercise wheel lets your hamster run in a more natural upright position — no arched backs, just smooth spinning fun. The textured blue running surface gives tiny feet extra grip, and the sturdy base keeps things steady while your little athlete logs their nightly miles. Why tiny paws love it: Saucer design encourages a natural running posture Textured running track for extra paw grip Sturdy, stable base for quieter nighttime zoomies A great outlet for that after-dinner burst of energy Good to know: Supervise play and discontinue use if the product becomes damaged. Choose with confidence: Make sure the saucer size suits your hamster's breed and size. Practical pet gear, clear details, and no guesswork — that's the WHO'S A GOOD BOY way.
item.g:brand: Who's A Good Boy Pet Accessories

item.g:title: Hamster Jogging Ball Track (4-Pack) - Blue
item.g:description: A track for ball-time fun. The Hamster Jogging Ball Track (4-Pack) gives hamsters a guided path for running in an exercise ball — the photos show the light blue circular track with its open lattice design, ready for your hamster's jogging ball. This 4-pack of connectable track pieces (check the product images to see how the pieces connect) lets hamsters run and explore along a set route instead of rolling freely across the room. Offered in Blue under Color. Perfect for hamster owners who want structured, supervised exercise time. Good to know: supervise all exercise ball play.
item.g:brand: Who's A Good Boy Pet Accessories

item.g:title: Hamster Sand Bath Container with Scoop (Large) - L 6.5*4.3*4.3 inches
item.g:description: A sand bath for a tidy hamster. The Hamster Sand Bath Container with Scoop (Large) gives your hamster a spot to roll and groom, with a scoop for easy cleanup. Large container: 6.5 x 4.3 x 4.3 in Scoop included Good to know: sand is sold separately unless shown in the images. Use sand made for your pet.
item.g:brand: Who's A Good Boy Pet Accessories

item.g:title: Wooden Hamster Maze Tunnel House - 20.8X19.8X6CM
item.g:description: A maze to explore. The Wooden Hamster Maze Tunnel House gives your hamster a wooden hideout with tunnels to explore. Wooden maze and tunnel design Size: 20.8 x 19.8 x 6 cm Good to know: check the size against your habitat and the product images, and supervise new accessories at first.
item.g:brand: Who's A Good Boy Pet Accessories

item.g:title: Aquarium Cooling Fan (2-Fan) - Standard
item.g:description: Help keep your tank cooler. The Aquarium Cooling Fan (2-Fan) is a two-fan unit that helps manage water temperature in warm conditions, lowering tank heat quietly with adjustable airflow to keep fish comfortable. The dual black fans mount to your tank rim with the clip-style bracket shown in the photos, blowing air across the water surface to promote cooling. Ideal for aquariums that run warm in summer or under strong lighting. Offered in the single Standard size. Good to know: check the product images for power needs and mounting, confirm it suits your tank, and monitor your water temperature regularly.
item.g:brand: Who's A Good Boy Pet Accessories

item.g:title: Aquascaping Tool Kit (Stainless Steel) - Black / 12 Inches 5-in-1
item.g:description: Everything for planting and styling your tank. The Aquascaping Tool Kit is a stainless steel 5-in-1 set for arranging plants, decor, and substrate — and for planting, trimming, and maintaining a beautiful aquarium. The 12-inch length reaches into deeper tanks while keeping your hands dry, and the set includes the essentials such as tweezers, a spatula, and scissors (check the product images to see exactly which tools are included). Offered in Black under Color, with a single 12 Inches 5-in-1 size. Ideal for planted-tank hobbyists who want precise control during setup and routine care. Rinse and dry the stainless steel tools after each use.
item.g:brand: Who's A Good Boy Pet Accessories

item.g:title: 2-Way Aquarium Air Pump Valve - 2 Way
item.g:description: Split your air supply. The 2-Way Aquarium Air Pump Valve sends air from one pump to two outputs, so you can run two air-driven devices — such as air stones or filters — off a single pump. Each outlet has a lever-controlled tap for precise airflow adjustment. The valve's barbed metal connectors grip airline tubing; check the product images and confirm the tubing size fits your air line before ordering. Ideal for aquarium hobbyists who want tidy, independent control of two accessories without adding a second pump. Offered in the single 2 Way size listed under Size.
item.g:brand: Who's A Good Boy Pet Accessories

item.g:title: Broken Vase Aquarium Fish House with Moss - Standard
item.g:description: A charming little hideaway for your fish! This broken vase aquarium decoration features a lifelike mossy, two-storey hut design that gives your tank a special look while providing shelter, hiding places and entertainment for your fish. Lifelike design: Japanese-inspired mossy hut adds natural beauty to your aquarium Fish-friendly: provides shelter and hiding spots that help fish feel secure Size: approx. 2.56 × 3.54 inches — please note this is a small decoration; check the size before ordering Please note: it’s normal for some green faux moss to come off after unpacking. Clean gently with a soft bristle brush before placing in the tank.
item.g:brand: Who's A Good Boy Pet Accessories

item.g:title: Aquarium Algae Scraper (6") - Standard
item.g:description: Clean glass, less effort. The Aquarium Algae Scraper (6 in) helps you wipe algae off your tank walls during routine maintenance. 6 in scraper for aquarium upkeep Good to know: check the product images for the blade type and confirm it is safe for your tank material (glass or acrylic) before use.
item.g:brand: Who's A Good Boy Pet Accessories

item.g:title: Aquarium Background 39" x 17" (Black Static Cling) - Black
item.g:description: Give your aquarium a sleek, professional backdrop! This black static cling background (39″ × 17″) instantly upgrades your fish tank’s look while helping your fish feel more secure. Double-sided design: paste on the OUTSIDE of your fish tank (not inside); peels off cleanly when not in use without leaving residue Enhances fish colors: the deep black background makes fish colors pop brighter while providing a sense of security Safe, non-toxic PET: high-quality, odorless material for use outside the aquarium; thickened so it won’t tear easily or let strong light through Easy to apply: wipe the surface clean, spray water on the cling side, position it, then smooth out air bubbles and water with a scraper Versatile décor: suitable for most fish tanks; a classic finishing touch for any aquarium
item.g:brand: Who's A Good Boy Pet Accessories

item.g:description: Keep your fish fed on schedule. The Aquarium Auto Feeder helps manage feeding for fish tanks, so your fish get fed even when you are busy. item.g:title: Parrot Foraging Shredding Toy - Standard
item.g:description: Bored beaks become destructive beaks. In the wild, parrots spend hours foraging and shredding every day — and pet birds need that same outlet. This foraging shredding toy gives your parrot something to tear into, pick apart, and explore, satisfying those deep natural instincts right in their cage. This gives them a healthy outlet for all that beak energy, which can help curb boredom-driven habits. Rotate it with your bird's other toys to keep things fresh, and watch a calmer, busier, happier bird emerge. For parrots, conures, cockatiels, and any feathered friend who needs a job to do. A busy beak is a happy beak.
item.g:brand: Who's A Good Boy Pet Accessories

item.g:title: Stainless Steel Bird Bowls (2-Pack) - 2 PCS Three screw ( L )
item.g:description: Keep your bird's cage tidy and their meals sorted. The Stainless Steel Bird Bowls (2-Pack) give your pet bird two separate dishes — one for seed and one for water — so feeding time stays clean and simple. Made from durable stainless steel, these bowls are easy to clean and built for daily use. They attach to the cage with screw clamp mounts (the Three screw style in size L), holding firm while your bird eats and drinks. Check the product images for size and how the bowls mount, and confirm they fit your cage before ordering. Rinse and wipe clean regularly to keep the bowls fresh for your feathered friend.
item.g:brand: Who's A Good Boy Pet Accessories

item.g:title: 15° Tilted Pet Bowl - Black

item.g:title: Interactive Squeaky Dog Toy - Blue / Remote Control
item.g:description: It moves. It squeaks. Your dog will lose their mind (in a good way). This is the toy for the dog who gets bored of regular toys in four minutes flat. It rolls, it darts, it squeaks — triggering the chase-pounce-play loop dogs are hardwired for. Why You'll Love It: Moves unpredictably on its own to trigger chase and pounce instincts Squeaks to keep your dog engaged long after you'd have quit throwing Remote Control version — you drive the chaos yourself USB Rechargeable version — endless play, no battery hunts Keeps solo pups stimulated when you're busy Good to know: Two versions — Remote Control (you steer) and USB Rechargeable (auto-play). Recharges via USB. Supervise play; retire worn toys. 🎯 Play with a purpose: the Squeak & Train Play Bundle pairs this toy with a durable bite stick — $44.08 (reg. $48.98).

item.g:title: Fluffy Donut Pet Bed - White Red / Small
item.g:description: The cuddle puddle your pet has been dreaming of. The Fluffy Donut Bed's raised rim creates a cozy nest that supports your pet's head and neck while they curl up — mimicking the secure feeling of snuggling into a pack. Pets who circle three times before lying down will feel instantly at home. The plush, fluffy surface is made for kneading, burrowing, and deep, twitchy-paw dreams. With a huge range of colors (from classic Black and Coffee to Fairy Pink and Gradient Deep Grey) and sizes from Small to XL, there's a donut for cats, small pups, and big sprawlers alike. Tip: choose a size up if your pet likes to stretch out, or true to size for dedicated curlers. Warning: you may find yourself jealous of how well they sleep.
item.g:brand: Who's A Good Boy Pet Accessories

Pets who circle three times before lying down will feel instantly at home. The plush, fluffy surface is made for kneading, burrowing, and deep, twitchy-paw dreams. With a huge range of colors (from classic Black and Coffee to Fairy Pink and Gradient Deep Grey) and sizes from Small to XL, there's a donut for cats, small pups, and big sprawlers alike. Tip: choose a size up if your pet likes to stretch out, or true to size for dedicated curlers. Warning: you may find yourself jealous of how well they sleep.

item.g:title: Cozy Winter Dog Hoodie - Red / S
item.g:description: Cold walks, canceled. The Cozy Winter Dog Hoodie keeps your pup warm when the temperature drops — from brisk fall mornings to full winter outings. The hoodie design covers the chest and back where dogs lose the most heat, so short-haired breeds and small pups can enjoy winter instead of shivering through it. Available in six colors (Red, Purple, Coffee, Blue, Orange, Pink) and six sizes (XS–XXL), so there's a fit for everything from tiny Chihuahuas to big lovable goofballs. Tip: measure your dog's chest and back length before ordering for the perfect fit. Because your dog deserves to look adorable AND stay toasty. Winter is coming — dress accordingly.
